# Equipment-sentence taxonomy -- 008 Setup phase re-measurement

- Generated: `2026-08-15T00:00:00Z`
- Retires risk **R-H** (partially -- see Methodology), sizes Open Decision **O1**, confirms the
  FR-021 ratchet baseline (T005, risk R-D)

**Non-destructive, and text-free.** Nothing under `data/`, `curation/`, or `state/` was written by
this report. No source sentence, model name, or item name appears on this page.

## Methodology -- read this before the numbers below

Same constraint as `reports/option-taxonomy/2026-08-15.md`: this sandboxed environment has no
route to wahapedia.ru, so `tools/equipment_taxonomy.py::measure()` (the live-acquisition path)
could not be re-run here. This report instead uses:

1. **`pipeline/parse/equipment_grammar.py`'s own module docstring** (006 research D1e) -- the last
   live measurement of the compound/conditional residual's per-subject shape: `Every [MODEL] with
   [ITEM]` (21 groups), `One [MODEL]` (18), `INT [MODEL]` (15), `A [MODEL]` (9), `For every INT
   models,` (6), `If the unit has INT models,` (2) -- 71 of a stated 104-group tail (against a
   measured baseline of 1932 groups over 1676 datacards). Restated in Section (a) below, **carried
   forward, not re-measured** -- classifying the *current* residual's subjects needs raw sentence
   text this environment cannot fetch.
2. **`data/wh40k-11e/`** and **`reports/wh40k-11e-2026-08-3/report.json`** -- this checkout's own
   committed curated tree and retained validation report for the published version (sha256
   `3aa1043d580780db05696024b42dfcd8cc5e7daf621db991b04df27aec4adebf`). The card-shape breakdown
   and the FR-021 ratchet-baseline confirmation below are **genuinely computed** from these.

**The aggregate residual is cross-checked, even though the per-subject split is not.** The current
corpus's `EQP-UNPARSED` count is **114** (`reports/wh40k-11e-2026-08-3/report.json`'s own
`findings`, counted by `finding_code`), against **99** in
`reports/footnote-restriction-taxonomy/2026-08-14.md` (the
same day, ~6 hours earlier) -- a 15-row same-day movement, the equipment side of the identical
corpus-drift pattern `reports/option-taxonomy/2026-08-15.md` reports for options (33 rows, 16%).
**R-H is therefore partially, not fully, retired**: the residual is confirmed present and, if
anything, larger than 006's own D1e measurement, but the current per-subject shares are not
re-derived here. The same residual action this leaves for **T074**'s mid-campaign dry-run applies:
a fresh live subject-classification run the moment a route to the corpus exists.

## Section (a): the compound/conditional tail's shape (carried forward, 006 research D1e)

| Subject shape | Groups (D1e measurement) | Class |
|---|---:|---|
| `Every [MODEL] with [ITEM] ...` | 21 | equipment-qualified (refused, no production planned) |
| `One [MODEL] ...` | 18 | subset (**O1**) |
| `INT [MODEL] ...` | 15 | subset (**O1**) |
| `A [MODEL] ...` | 9 | subset (**O1**) |
| `For every INT models, ...` | 6 | conditional (refused, no production planned) |
| `If the unit has INT models, ...` | 2 | conditional (refused, no production planned) |
| **O1's own number: One + INT + A** | **42** | the non-predicate, non-conditional subset family |

## Reading this

- **`equipment_qualified` and `conditional` are refused on the same terms options' `refused_
  conditional_or_equipment_qualified` class is** -- resolving either publishes a model group
  nobody can find, or a permission the source did not state unconditionally. No production is
  planned for either.
- **The `One`/`INT`/`A` subset family (42 groups, 006 D1e) is exactly what Open Decision O1
  decides**: curator override under `curation/equipment-overrides.json` (option A, recommended --
  zero schema change) or an additive `applies_to_max_count` column (option B).

**T051 execution note (2026-08-17, Phase 5/US3 session).** Per rule 5, the same terms T043 applied
to `_COMPLETION_HEADS`: `pipeline/parse/equipment_grammar.py::_COMPLETION_SUBJECTS` stays empty
after Phase 5, because there is no reachable subject shape left to write a production against.
`_SUBJECTS`'s own sixth entry — the bare `^(\S.*)$` production research D1e already built for the
residual tail below its five named shapes — matches *every* non-empty subject that is not one of
`_REFUSED`'s five patterns. Confirmed directly (`parse_sentence("Any Sentry is equipped with: a
lantern.")` and `"All Sentries are equipped with: ..."` both resolve today, and neither is a fixed
`_SUBJECTS` phrase nor a `_REFUSED` shape) and independently confirmed by `test_equipment_grammar.
py::test_a_compound_or_conditional_subject_is_refused` (006-era, pre-008, unmodified), which
already parametrizes one representative of all six rows in Section (a)'s table above and asserts
every one refused by design — the module's own docstring states it plainly: "The tail is refused,
not approximated." There is therefore no subject shape that is simultaneously non-refused and
unmatched by `_SUBJECTS`; every reachable subject already resolves through 006's own six
productions, and every unreachable one is a `_REFUSED` member (the equipment-qualified 21 +
subset 42 + conditional 8 = 71 groups this table already accounts for). FR-008's "multi-model-group
differentiated-equipment shape" already resolves per-sentence under 006's grammar today — the
47-datasheet residual this feature targets is entirely the O1 subset family (routed to Phase 7)
and the permanently refused equipment-qualified/conditional tail, never a missing production.
Proven end to end (not just at the `parse_sentence` unit level) against `GF24` through `_equipment`
in `tests/enrichment/test_equipment_grammar.py`'s Phase 5 tests.
